title: Rebrand Strategy & Discovery
tldr: First discovery call with Dr. Brandon Imada, a chiropractor connected to Top Rock through Justin (a patient). Brandon wants to rebrand from "Surf N Sport Chiropractic" to "Vital Alignments" — a name that's less niche and captures his evolving philosophy that real healing is about adjusting beliefs, mindset, body, emotions and spirit, not just the table adjustment. His priority stack: (1) rebrand → (2) new website / landing page → (3) a content platform (blog + YouTube + downloadable PDFs) → (4) paid programs/courses, with one-on-one care as the high-ticket funnel goal. His old WordPress/Duda site (built by designer "Hayes") feels dated — a patient once said it "looks like a Word document you just published." Top Rock pitched their model: not a traditional branding agency, but technical + business operators who leverage AI to iterate fast and cheap — they'll generate several full mockup directions to click through instead of a slow weeks-long mood-board process. Agreed next step: Top Rock drafts a proposal (with a small AI down-payment); Brandon gathers his brand notes/materials and sits with what matters most for the rebrand; then a more structured, transcribed brand session.

actionItems.action: Gather existing brand content/notes (notepads, prior AI work, docs) and send to Top Rock.
Sit with the rebrand and get clear on what matters most right now; add fresh notes for the next session.
Put brains together and draft a proposal (deliverables + small AI down payment).
Schedule a more structured, transcribed brand session once the proposal is approved.
Generate the first round of mockup directions from Brandon's vision.
